info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Tasks API

items.docs: All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of tasks (except for candidateGroupIn which is only available in this POST task query REST service), but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long. params.name: taskId
params.description: Only return tasks with the given id.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return tasks with the given version.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return tasks with a name like the given name.

params.name: nameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return tasks with a name like the given name ignoring case.

params.name: description
params.description: Only return tasks with the given description.

params.name: priority
params.description: Only return tasks with the given priority.

params.name: minimumPriority
params.description: Only return tasks with a priority greater than the given value.

params.name: maximumPriority
params.description: Only return tasks with a priority lower than the given value.

params.name: assignee
params.description: Only return tasks assigned to the given user.

params.name: assigneeLike
params.description: Only return tasks assigned with an assignee like the given value.

params.name: owner
params.description: Only return tasks owned by the given user.

params.name: ownerLike
params.description: Only return tasks assigned with an owner like the given value.

params.name: unassigned
params.description: Only return tasks that are not assigned to anyone. If false is passed, the value is ignored.

params.name: delegationState
params.description: Only return tasks that have the given delegation state. Possible values are pending and resolved.

params.name: candidateUser
params.description: Only return tasks that can be claimed by the given user. This includes both tasks where the user is an explicit candidate for and task that are claimable by a group that the user is a member of.

params.name: candidateGroup
params.description: Only return tasks that can be claimed by a user in the given group.

params.name: candidateGroups
params.description: Only return tasks that can be claimed by a user in the given groups. Values split by comma.

params.name: involvedUser
params.description: Only return tasks in which the given user is involved.

params.name: taskDefinitionKey
params.description: Only return tasks with the given task definition id.

params.name: taskDefinitionKeyLike
params.description: Only return tasks with a given task definition id like the given value.

params.name: taskDefinitionKeys
params.description: Only return tasks with the given task definition ids.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of the process instance with the given id.

params.name: processInstanceIdWithChildren
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of the process instance and its children with the given id.

params.name: withoutProcessInstanceId
params.description: If true, only returns tasks without a process instance id set. If false, the withoutProcessInstanceId parameter is ignored.

params.name: processInstanceBusinessKey
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of the process instance with the given business key.

params.name: processInstanceBusinessKeyLike
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of the process instance which has a business key like the given value.

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of a process instance which has a process definition with the given id.

params.name: processDefinitionKey
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of a process instance which has a process definition with the given key.

params.name: processDefinitionKeyLike
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of a process instance which has a process definition with a key like the given value.

params.name: processDefinitionName
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of a process instance which has a process definition with the given name.

params.name: processDefinitionNameLike
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of a process instance which has a process definition with a name like the given value.

params.name: executionId
params.description: Only return tasks which are part of the execution with the given id.

params.name: createdOn
params.description: Only return tasks which are created on the given date.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Only return tasks which are created before the given date.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Only return tasks which are created after the given date.

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Only return tasks which are due on the given date.

params.name: dueBefore
params.description: Only return tasks which are due before the given date.

params.name: dueAfter
params.description: Only return tasks which are due after the given date.

params.name: withoutDueDate
params.description: Only return tasks which do not have a due date. The property is ignored if the value is false.

params.name: excludeSubTasks
params.description: Only return tasks that are not a subtask of another task.

params.name: active
params.description: If true, only return tasks that are not suspended (either part of a process that is not suspended or not part of a process at all). If false, only tasks that are part of suspended process instances are returned.

params.name: includeTaskLocalVariables
params.description: Indication to include task local variables in the result.

params.name: includeProcessVariables
params.description: Indication to include process variables in the result.

params.name: scopeDefinitionId
params.description: Only return tasks with the given scopeDefinitionId.

params.name: scopeId
params.description: Only return tasks with the given scopeId.

params.name: scopeIds
params.description: Only return tasks with one of the given scopeIds.

params.name: withoutScopeId
params.description: If true, only returns tasks without a scope id set. If false, the withoutScopeId parameter is ignored.

params.name: scopeType
params.description: Only return tasks with the given scopeType.

params.name: propagatedStageInstanceId
params.description: Only return tasks which have the given id as propagated stage instance id

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return tasks with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return tasks with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns tasks without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: candidateOrAssigned
params.description: Select tasks that has been claimed or assigned to user or waiting to claim by user (candidate user or groups).

params.name: category
params.description: Select tasks with the given category. Note that this is the task category, not the category of the process definition (namespace within the BPMN Xml).

params.name: categoryIn
params.description: Select tasks for the given categories. Note that this is the task category, not the category of the process definition (namespace within the BPMN Xml).

params.name: categoryNotIn
params.description: Select tasks which are not assigned to the given categories. Does not return tasks without categories. Note that this is the task category, not the category of the process definition (namespace within the BPMN Xml).

params.name: withoutCategory
params.description: Select tasks without a category assigned. Note that this is the task category, not the category of the process definition (namespace within the BPMN Xml).

params.name: rootScopeId
params.description: Only return tasks which have the given root scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: parentScopeId
params.description: Only return tasks which have the given parent scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.

items.docs: All request values are optional. For example, you can only include the assignee attribute in the request body JSON-object, only updating the assignee of the task, leaving all other fields unaffected. When an attribute is explicitly included and is set to null, the task-value will be updated to null. Example: {"dueDate" : null} will clear the duedate of the task).

params.name: cascadeHistory
params.description: Whether or not to delete the HistoricTask instance when deleting the task (if applicable). If not provided, this value defaults to false.

params.name: deleteReason
params.description: Reason why the task is deleted. This value is ignored when cascadeHistory is true.

info.name: Create new variables on a task

items.docs:
This endpoint can be used in 2 ways: By passing a JSON Body (RestVariable or an Array of RestVariable) or by passing a multipart/form-data Object.
It is possible to create simple (non-binary) variable or list of variables or new binary variable 
Any number of variables can be passed into the request body array.
NB: Swagger V2 specification does not support this use case that is why this endpoint might be buggy/incomplete if used with other tools.
